data.content: A printable Christmas murder mystery for 8 players set at Hollyridge Lodge. Inside: host guide, party timeline and host script, invitations, 8 character booklets, 9 clue cards played over 3 rounds, detective notes, the solution, and name tags with awards. Print at home and host a whodunit dinner party for adults and teens.

A printable Secret Santa kit for an office or family gift exchange, 11 pages. Inside: how-to guide, organizer page and sign-up, Secret Santa questionnaire, gift idea starter list, name-draw slips, rules, White Elephant and dice swap rules, a who-has-who tracker, cut-out gift tags and thank-you notes. Print at home and run the whole exchange in one night.

A printable Christmas escape room for kids and families: The Bell Vault. Inside: a game master guide, a mission letter, 4 clues in two levels (ages 6-9 and 10+), the final lock page, envelope lock tags, hint cards, an answer key and escape expert certificates. About 45 minutes of screen-free puzzles for a family night, a class party or a Christmas get-together. Print at home.

An editable Christmas coupon book you type and print at home. Inside: front and back covers, 30 coupons in three books (partner, kids and family, 10 each), 5 blank coupons to write your own and a fold-up gift envelope. Type the names and details in the PDF, then print, cut and assemble. A small, personal stocking stuffer.

A printable Christmas cookie exchange party kit. Inside: host guide, fill-in invitations, host countdown, guest sign-up sheet, swap rules and baking math, recipe cards, cookie labels, best cookie ballots, a voting tally with 4 award cards, thank-you cards, take-home box tags and a recipe swap list. 13 pages, US Letter, print at home.

A printable family advent countdown: 24 activity cards for December 1 to 24, blank cards for your own traditions, a countdown tracker, a plan-ahead supply list and a family memories page. One small activity a day; 7 of the 24 need nothing at all. Print, cut and start on December 1.

A set of 6 printable pink Christmas Bible verse prints in KJV: Luke 2:14, Luke 2:11, Isaiah 9:6, Luke 2:10, Matthew 2:10 and a bow print. Each print comes in 3 sizes. Print at home or at a print shop and frame for Christmas decor. Digital download, no physical item.

24 printable no-prep games for an office Christmas party: coworker holiday bingo, holiday word scramble, trivia showdown, letter lists, guess the coworker and more, with a 45-minute run sheet, game finder, team score sheet and answer keys. Print and play with teams of coworkers.

A printable Christmas escape room for teens and adults: The Snowbound Lodge. 8 linked puzzles lead to a locked gift vault, with a host guide, lock sheet, hint cards, team timer and scores, answer key and a certificate of escape. 2 to 20 players in teams, 45 to 60 minutes. US Letter.

A printable Christmas morning scavenger hunt: 24 rhyming clue cards in two levels (Little Elves for early readers, Big Kid Riddles for older kids), a setup sheet and answer key, blank cards to write your own and final gift cards. Hide the clues the night before and lead the kids to their gift.

Seven printable Friendsgiving games in one 15-page kit: Friendsgiving trivia, Would You Rather, Most Likely To, Leftover Scramble, 4 bingo cards, Find a Friend Who and thankful toast cards, with answer keys and a team scorecard. Also a potluck sign-up, host timeline and leftover labels. For adults and groups of friends. US Letter or A4.

An 11-page printable kit to run a Secret Santa or white elephant exchange at work, school or with family. Inside: organizer page and sign-up sheet, a 14-question Secret Santa questionnaire, a gift idea list by budget, 24 name-draw slips, rules, white elephant and dice swap rules, a who-has-who tracker, 12 cut-out gift tags and 6 thank-you notes. Print at home on US Letter or A4.

A printable Christmas party bundle: 6 party games, 12 party awards, a white elephant dice game, a left-right gift story and a gingerbread house contest with score cards and ribbons. Host timeline and answer keys included. Print at home for a family, office or friends Christmas party.

A printable Christmas murder mystery for 8 players: The Stolen Star of Hollyridge Lodge. Inside: host guide and party timeline, invitations, 8 character booklets with secrets and 3 rounds, 9 clue cards, detective notes, the solution and name tags with 2 awards. Print at home and host a whodunit dinner party for adults and teens.

A printable Secret Santa questionnaire everyone fills in before the draw: 14 questions from favorite snack and drink to sizes, allergies and a dream small gift. The kit also has a gift idea list by budget (under $10, $20 and $30), name-draw slips, a tracker, gift tags and thank-you notes. 11 pages for office, school or family exchanges. US Letter or A4.

A 15-page printable Friendsgiving kit for a table of friends: 7 games (trivia, Would You Rather, Most Likely To, Leftover Scramble, bingo, Find a Friend Who and thankful toast cards) with answer keys, plus a potluck sign-up, a host timeline, a team scorecard and leftover labels. Print at home on US Letter or A4.

Eight printable New Year's Eve games for kids, teens and grown-ups: trivia and a word scramble with answer keys, This or That, Would You Rather cards, Find the Guest bingo, My 2026 in Review, My Predictions for 2027 and a countdown scavenger hunt, plus a party scorecard. For 3 to 30 players, pens and paper only, no drinking games. 12 pages, US Letter or A4.

Six editable letters from Santa for different kinds of years: the Nice List, baby's first Christmas, a new big sibling, a kindness star, a hard year and a new home. Type your child's name and three good things right into the PDF in free Adobe Reader, no Canva or account. Also inside: a Nice List certificate, a checked-twice list, a wish list, North Pole envelope labels and 12 gift tags from Santa. 14 pages.

A Christmas morning treasure hunt that ends at the big gift. 24 clue cards in two levels: Little Elves rhymes for early readers (about ages 4 to 7) and Big Kid Riddles for ages 8 to 12. A parent setup sheet and answer key, blank cards for your own spots and Final Gift cards are included. Print on US Letter or A4 and hide the clues the night before. 13 pages.

24 Christmas activity cards, one for each night of December: write letters to Santa, build a blanket fort, bake cookies, take a winter walk and more. Each card has a short idea, a talk-about-it question and what you need (many need nothing). Includes blank cards for your own traditions, a countdown tracker, a supply list and a family memories page. For kids 4 to 12 and their grown-ups. 13 printable pages.

One 18-page printable file for a whole Christmas party: word scramble, This or That, Would You Rather, trivia quiz, Find the Guest Who and charades cards, 12 party award certificates, a white elephant dice game with a left-right story, and a gingerbread house contest with judge score cards and ribbons. A host timeline is included. For family, friends or office parties. Print at home on US Letter or A4.

Everything to host a Christmas cookie swap in one 13-page printable: fill-in invitations, a host countdown, guest sign-up sheet, swap rules with baking math, recipe cards, cookie labels with allergen checkboxes, best cookie ballots, a voting tally with 4 awards, thank-you cards and take-home box tags. Print on US Letter or A4.

120 Christmas charades cards for a big group: 40 kids cards, 40 family cards and 40 adults cards with grown-up holiday moments like hosting the in-laws and the Secret Santa reveal. Includes how-to-play rules, a Draw It bonus mode, a team score sheet and blank cards. For family nights, friends and office parties. Print on US Letter or A4, cut and play. 16 pages.

A printable Christmas escape room for adults and teens. The Snowbound Lodge has 8 linked puzzles, each answer opening the next lock, plus a host guide, lock sheet, 8 two-step hint cards, a team timer and score sheet, an answer key for the host and a certificate. For 2 to 20 players in teams of 2 to 5, about 45 to 60 minutes. A 16-page US Letter PDF you print at home for an office party, game night or family Christmas.

36 kind, funny Christmas party awards for the office, family or friends. The 13-page kit has the award list with a line to read aloud for each, nomination cards and sheets, a vote tally sheet, a host script, award certificates, fill-in certificates and a Hall of Fame page. Print on US Letter or A4 and run the whole awards moment from one file.
